app.title: Regionagro
field.title: Where is your field?
field.description: Start by choosing your land. We will use its location to find relevant climate and soil data.
field.instructionOne: Find your area on the map.
field.instructionTwo: Zoom in until the green field outlines appear and click your field. If there is no outline, the clicked point is used.
field.instructionThree: Choose what grew on the field in the last three years and press “Analyze field”.
field.pendingDescription: The field location and area will appear here after selection.
scaffold.apiDown: not reachable. Is "npm run dev" running?
disclaimer: This tool supports decisions and does not replace a local agronomist.
field.pointDescription: No field boundary found here, so the analysis uses the point.
result.title: Analysis of the selected location
result.dataStatus: Some data is not live. Climate: {climate}; soil: {soil}; terrain: {terrain}.
result.growingSeason: Months with mean temperature of 5 °C or more
result.frostFree: Months with mean daily minimum above 0 °C
field.ftwDescription: Boundary from Fields of the World (satellite model), about {area} ha. Check that it matches your field.
history.title: What grew on this field?
history.description: Pick the crops of the last three years. Agronomy guides advise not returning a crop to the same field more often than about once in four years, so three past years plus the coming season cover that window.
result.avoid: What not to sow next year
result.avoidNone: No crop from the list had to be excluded.
